changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Allow reporting managers or the tenant HR_ADMIN role to act on the first step of the standard expense and travel workflows.
changeSet.sql: WITH hr_role AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (tenant_id) tenant_id, id AS role_id FROM "${schema}".role WHERE UPPER(TRIM(name)) = 'HR_ADMIN' AND is_deleted = false ORDER BY tenant_id, id ) UPDATE "${schema}".workflow_step workflow_step SET approver_type = 'REPORTING_MANAGER_OR_ROLE', approver_role_id = hr_role.role_id, updated_at = NOW() FROM "${schema}".workflow workflow, hr_role WHERE workflow_step.workflow_id = workflow.id AND workflow_step.tenant_id = workflow.tenant_id AND hr_role.tenant_id = workflow.tenant_id AND workflow.is_active = true AND workflow.entity_type IN ('EXPENSE', 'TRAVEL_REQUEST') AND workflow.name IN ('Expense Approval', 'Travel pre-approval') AND workflow_step.sequence_order = 1 AND UPPER(TRIM(workflow_step.approver_type)) IN ('REPORTING_MANAGER', 'MANAGER', 'LINE_MANAGER');

changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Accounting approvers are employees too; grant ordinary self punch and missed-punch access without granting privileged regularization.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO "${schema}".role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT tenant_role.id, permission.id FROM "${schema}".role tenant_role JOIN "${schema}".permission permission ON permission.resource = 'attendance' AND permission.action = 'punch_self' JOIN kabipay_ops.module module ON module.id = permission.module_id AND module.code = 'ATTENDANCE' WHERE UPPER(TRIM(tenant_role.name)) = 'ACCOUNTING_APPROVER' AND tenant_role.is_deleted = false ON CONFLICT (role_id, permission_id) DO NOTHING;
